_catalogNote: Kimi fields (2026-09-10): active, cardDescription, capabilityTags, intentTags{primary,secondary} (taxonomy.json ids), audiences{companySize,creatorVolume,geography} (bands from taxonomy.json — a product that declares a band scores a fit on it and a mismatch outside it; one that declares none is neutral), excludesIntents (use-case mismatch), conversion{primaryType DEMO|SELF_SERVICE|EXPERT_CALL, primaryLabel, secondaryLabel}, urls{productPage,externalWebsite,demo,selfService}, visual. The recommendation cards render from these and from nothing else; the older fields (positioning, whoFor, valueProps, url, signupUrl, lockup) still drive /products and /s/{id}.
_aliasesNote: `aliases`: the product's name as people type it and as speech-to-text hears it. A named product goes straight to the top of the running (recommend.js nameMentions → its primary intents, explicit). Never a plain word that means something else ('machine' alone is not The Machine).
